summary: This bill directs the Secretary of Health and Human Services to establish drug adherence guidelines, incorporating artificial intelligence and machine learning, to achieve 90 percent adherence for all Medicare Part B and D drugs, while promoting the use of generic and biosimilar drugs.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly addresses healthcare by establishing drug adherence guidelines for Medicare Part B and D drugs, aiming to improve health outcomes for beneficiaries. It focuses on optimizing the use of existing healthcare services and medications.

The bill is primarily focused on drug adherence, specifically for Medicare Part B and D drugs, and promotes the use of generic and biosimilar drugs. This falls squarely within the realm of drug policy, aiming to improve the effectiveness and potentially the cost-efficiency of drug use.
